name: application-donut-chart
title: Donut Chart
description: Multi-segment proportion ring with a real computed center total and a color-keyed legend — each segment's arc length is derived from its share of the whole via SVG stroke-dasharray.
useWhen: Showing how a total breaks down into a small number of categories (e.g. traffic sources, budget allocation).
You want the center of the ring to display the real computed total, not a hand-typed number.
A compact ring plus legend fits better than a full bar or table for 3–6 categories.
avoidWhen: You have many categories (8+) — the ring gets crowded and thin slices become unreadable; use a table or bar chart instead.
You need a single metric against one target — use progress-ring-cluster (single dials) or bullet-chart instead.
Precise per-category comparison matters more than proportion-of-whole — a bar chart communicates that better.
responsiveBehavior: The ring is a fixed-size SVG (default 160px) next to a legend list; scale the `size` prop for the surrounding layout rather than relying on CSS scaling.
accessibility: Each ring segment carries role='img' with an aria-label stating the category name and value, since arc length alone isn't announced by screen readers.
Every segment also appears in the visible legend with a color swatch, label, and exact value.
The center total is real text, not an image, so it's selectable and readable by assistive tech.

variants.title: Donut chart
variants.description: Four-segment traffic-sources donut (Direct/Organic/Referral/Social) with a center total of 100 and a legend, on a light surface.
accessibility: Segment color is supplementary; the legend's label and numeric value carry the precise data.

variants.title: Donut chart (Dark)
variants.description: The same four-segment traffic-sources donut, adapted for dark surfaces with lightened segment colors for contrast.
accessibility: Segment, center text, and legend colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
